page.overview:
Who is Audrey Myers?

Audrey Myers was the wife of Mr. Myers and the mother of Michael Myers, Judith Myers and Laurie Strode. When Audrey gave birth to Michael, she was in labor for three days and on October 31, 1957, she finally gave birth to a stillborn Michael, who was officially pronounced alive at 12:06 am on November 1. On the night of October 31, 1963, Audrey and her husband went out that night and left their two younger children in Mrs. Blankenship's care. Once they returned home, they found Michael standing outside with a bloody knife and his clown mask on. Mr. Myers took off the mask and wondered what had happened. They soon discovered that Judith was dead and Michael was the murderer. The Myers had Michael sent to Smith's Grove Sanitarium. Audrey would often call Michael's doctor, Sam Loomis, to check-up on her son's progress, but it was always the same news. Audrey and her husband eventually died in 1965.
